blocks.text: (Published in the Topeka Metro News June 29, 2026)
ORDINANCE NO. 20666
AN ORDINANCE introduced by City Manager, Robert M. Perez, allowing and approving
City expenditures for the period of May 2, 2026, to May 29, 2026, and
enumerating said expenditures herein. 9
BE IT ORDAINED BY THE COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF TOPEKA, KANSAS:
Section 1. All expenditures made or authorized to be made by issuance of checks
or electronic transfers as enumerated herein, are in accordance with City of Topeka
Resolution No. 7607.
Section 2. The claims and expenditures listed in Exhibit A, which is on file in the
City Council Office and the City Clerk’s Office and incorporated herein by said reference,
are hereby allowed and approved for payment.
Section 3. Total of 358 vendor checks written this period 3,052,415.60
Total of 1,352 ACH transfers to vendors this period 11,027,628.02
Total of 3,160 payroll electronic transfers this period 4,802,883.29
Total of 1 payroll check written this period 5,987.39
Total of 1 voided vendor check this period -195.46
Total for expenditures in this period $18,888,718.84
Section 4. This ordinance shall take effect and be in force after its passage,
approval and publication in the official city newspaper.
26 PASSED and APPROVED by the Governing Body June 16, 2026.
CITY OF TOPEKA, KANSAS
29 ATTEST: Spencer Duncan, Mayor 30
33 Brenda Younger, City Clerk
